title: SAR scan shows shaft system coming out of the bottom of the Queen's Chamber
summary: Jeffrey tells of SAR scan shows shaft system coming out of the bottom of the Queen's Chamber, about 2020 at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Queen's Chamber, Great Pyramid, Giza, Egypt

tellings.quote: And what they're showing here is actually the presence of a shaft system coming out of the bottom of the Queen's Chamber.

plain: A researcher called Jeffrey, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a 2020 scientific paper by researchers he names as Filippo and Corrado. The paper used a satellite radar method that reads tiny vibrations inside solid structures to look into the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt. Jeffrey says the images show a system of shafts running down from the bottom of the Queen's Chamber, one of the pyramid's inner rooms, which would point to hidden structures beneath the pyramid.
